title: DAO RX floor catalog requires durably-anchored state outside base_dir; enforce/document
description: Security review of worker6-bidu fix: if dao_rx_catalog.bin, both per-key slot files, AND the anchor state are all absent, load_rx_floor degrades to first-DAO bootstrap and old signed DAOs replay. Slot files and catalog live in the same directory with identical permissions, so any actor able to delete slots can delete the catalog; protection only holds when StateRevisionAnchor is externally durable. Fix: enforce or document that production construction requires a durable anchor stored outside base_dir (e.g. requires_durable_anchor flag or gateway-config assertion) and add a test asserting the fail-open path is unreachable with the durable anchor. Ref dao_persistence.py:625-627,722-725,992-1007.
